claims.statement: UNESCO identifies Sanchi as a major Buddhist sanctuary from the third century BCE through the first century CE.
Ashoka’s pillar and a brick stupa were followed by enlargement and ornamentation under later dynasties.
The map uses UNESCO’s reference position for Early Buddhist Sanchi, not a territorial boundary.

evidence.locator: Brief synthesis and criterion (iii); site coordinate listing
evidence.note: An early sanctuary phase, not the full duration of Sanchi. Buildings and additions belong to different dates; the site continued long after 100 CE. The marker is UNESCO’s archaeological site reference.
